dimensions_mm.notes: 6 NMC/Si-graphite 21700 cells; second-life INR21700-M50T cells under residential and commercial grid-storage duty cycles; shares cell ids with dataset_25; Moy et al. Data in Brief 2024

conditions.protocol_charge_raw: second-life grid-storage synthetic duty cycles (residential and commercial)

CC-CV charge at 1.455 A to 4.2 V with 50 mA cutoff, then 1 h rest; CC discharge at 1C for 30 min to about 42% SOC; then five repeats of a 48 h residential or commercial grid-storage synthetic power profile (about 10 days per batch), cycling chamber alternating between 20 °C and 35 °C; reference performance tests at 25 °C
conditions.protocol_discharge_raw: Reference test: C/20 discharge with 8 s C/2 pulses at 4.00, 3.63 and 3.26 V, discharge to 2.5 V; EIS at the same voltages (0.01 Hz-10 kHz) from RPT S-5; calendar aging at room temperature between batches

quality.notes: Six second-life NMC cells cycled with residential and commercial duty cycles at Stanford. Cell ids G1, V4, V5 also appear in dataset_25. Cell spec is from LG's INR21700 M50 18.2Wh document (2017-09-22), the closest available datasheet to the exact M50T tab variant this dataset names; electrical/physical specs are expected to match across M50-series tab variants. Charge/discharge rate estimates, where explicitly marked raw_data in the citations, use signed observed current extrema divided by the stored nominal Ah. These are measurement estimates over the cached extraction scope, not imposed CC protocol setpoints; they may include pulse, dynamic, regenerative or diagnostic segments and measurement excursions. Current units and direction were checked against the cited original headers, status labels or separate charge/discharge counters. cached extraction covers six cells and parsed cycling, RPT and EIS workbook parts; the positive maximum includes diagnostic RPT charge rather than the grid-storage cycling protocol alone. stored nominal capacity 5.0 Ah comes from the nearest LG M50 datasheet, with an existing exact M50T model caveat; the inspected cycling workbook Global_Info Capacity field is 4.85. No denominator is inferred from measured current. Finite auxiliary temperature readings exist, but the sensor placement on the cell versus ambient air was not established; measured cell-temperature availability is therefore unclear.

Six second-life NMC cells cycled with residential and commercial duty cycles at Stanford. Cell ids G1, V4, V5 also appear in dataset_25. Cell spec is from LG's INR21700 M50 18.2Wh document (2017-09-22), the closest available datasheet to the exact M50T tab variant this dataset names; electrical/physical specs are expected to match across M50-series tab variants. Charge/discharge rate estimates, where explicitly marked raw_data in the citations, use signed observed current extrema divided by the stored nominal Ah. These are measurement estimates over the cached extraction scope, not imposed CC protocol setpoints; they may include pulse, dynamic, regenerative or diagnostic segments and measurement excursions. Current units and direction were checked against the cited original headers, status labels or separate charge/discharge counters. cached extraction covers six cells and parsed cycling, RPT and EIS workbook parts; the positive maximum includes diagnostic RPT charge rather than the grid-storage cycling protocol alone. nominal capacity 4.85 Ah and nominal voltage 3.63 V are from the data article's Table 1, matching the cycling workbook Global_Info Capacity field; the earlier 5.0 Ah came from the generic LG M50 datasheet and is superseded. Table 1 also gives 21.44 mm x 70.80 mm and 69.25 g, which differs from the datasheet maxima (21.1 x 70.15 mm); the paper values are used. No denominator is inferred from measured current. Finite auxiliary temperature readings exist, but the sensor placement on the cell versus ambient air was not established; measured cell-temperature availability is therefore unclear. Charging profile: the duty cycles (residential and commercial) are time-varying for every cell; the charge is CC-CV at one level. No documentation ships with the dataset. The data article is "Second-life lithium-ion battery aging dataset based on grid storage cycling", Data in Brief 2024 (10.1016/j.dib.2024.111046). Cell groups per the article: residential profile V4, W9, W10; commercial W8, V5, G1; first-life charge rates C/4, C/2, 1C, 1C, 3C, 3C (first-life data in the related article Pozzato et al., Data in Brief 2022, 10.1016/j.dib.2022.107995). Campaign runs 24 months from 2022-10-28; data shared up to 2024-10-06. Equipment: Arbin LBT21024 cycler, Amerex IC500R thermal chamber, Gamry EIS 1010E, T-type thermocouple on the cell surface centre. Chamber alternates 20 and 35 °C between batches. Raw data OSF DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/8JNR5. The recorded rate maxima are the documented protocol maxima (0.5C pulses, 1C discharge), not the raw-current estimates. Rate groups: the 0.3C CC-CV charge against the 8 s C/2 charge and discharge pulses of the reference tests.
